detail.longDescription: Crossed 173 merged PRs into other people's repos. Before that number does any work on you: 137 more were closed without merging, so the decided-merge rate is about 56%, and most of the merged ones are small fixes in small repos. What actually moved things this week was boring. Rebase what maintainers already approved, fix the CI they flagged, then stop talking. https:// github.com/mahirhir # OpenSource # GitHub
